items.title: Supercharge the Teamwork Graph with People Context
items.summary: Every piece of work your teams do has people behind it. The Jira issue has an assignee. The design doc has an author. The pull request has reviewers, and the Slack thread has the people deciding what happens next. The Teamwork Graph already connects that work across Atlassian and the tools you connect to it. […]The post Supercharge the Teamwork Graph with People Context appeared first on Inside Atlassian.
items.creator: Augusto Valdez
